t: The Damplas Vapour Control Layer is an essential building membrane designed to manage moisture within structures. This effective vapour barrier restricts the passage of water vapour through walls and ceilings, preventing condensation and protecting timber frames from dampness. It is ideal for new build and renovation projects, including use as a flooring underlay or within external wall insulation systems. The durable 500 gauge green layer is water and rot-proof, offering long-lasting protection.
b: Prevents Moisture Transfer to Timber Frames
